does: Scores for the AI a boost status applied to a target for a number of turns: what the status's boosts are worth to the target.

evidence.says: the AI log line for entering a status with its turn count; calls into the boost scoring of the AI helpers

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (the segments where an enemy took its turn), 314 times from 2 places, among them the status scorer at +0x37800B0
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the text constants both refer to
